5 friends — Anya, Chetan, Esha, Bilal, and Divya — sit around a circular table, facing the center. Study the clues below and answer the questions that follow.

- There are exactly 1 people between Chetan and Bilal, going clockwise from Chetan.
- There are exactly 1 people between Divya and Chetan, going clockwise from Divya.
- Divya sits immediately clockwise of Bilal.
- There are exactly 1 people between Esha and Divya, going clockwise from Esha.
